PositionRef.description: One repo's position. Serialises as `{"repo","commit","dirty"}`, absent parts as `null`.

commit.description: 40 lower-case hex, or `None` for a directory with no commit.

dirty.description: 64 lower-case hex, or `None` when the checkout is clean.

exact.description: The index reflects the live position exactly.

live.description: The checkout's position as it is now.

reflected.description:
What the context's index reflects, per repo; empty when no board is found or nothing is
recorded yet.
